column1: # Measured ignition delay times, Petersen, Davidson & Hanson, "Ignition Delay Times of Ram Accelerator
# CH4/O2/Diluent Mixtures", J. Propulsion and Power 15(1) 82-91 (1999), doi:10.2514/2.5394.
# Read value by value FROM THE PAGE IMAGES (300 dpi) on 2026-11-21: Table 2 "Experimental ignition delay
# time data", journal page 86; mixtures from Table 1, journal page 84.  One row per measured point, in
# the table's own order (the P, T and tau lists of each group are read pairwise, left to right, top line
# then bottom line).  tau_ign_us: footnote a, sidewall pressure measurement (corrected to the endwall,
# Eq. 1, p. 84) unless `note` says d (endwall pressure) or g (HeNe laser extinction).  tau_emis_us:
# footnote b, visible emission unless e (CH4 3.3 um) or f (CH 431 nm); "-" where the table prints a dash;
# a value in parentheses in the table (footnote c, onset of deflagration) is in `emis_note`.
# Ignition delay definition (p. 83, Fig. 1): t_F - t_C, t_C the arrival of the normal reflected shock,
# t_F the arrival of the ignition front = the extrapolation of the steepest pressure rise.  Overall
# uncertainty of tau_ign +-10 us (p. 85); T5 initial error ~5 K, average over the induction < 15 K (p. 84).
